entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Have you thought about how Vina wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you thought about how Vina will react?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""What will Her Highness say when sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "What will Her Highness say when she comes back from Pales to a Rizia reformed by violent means?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We aren't close anymore, as you kn..."
entries.dialogueText: "We aren't close anymore, as you know. But I don't believe she'd want to see Rizia reformed by violent means."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Both you and I know she'd never wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Both you and I know she'd never want to see Rizia reformed by violent means."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She's got more of a spine than you..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's got more of a spine than you do. She'll understand that this is necessary for the greater good."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll make sure she's safely out of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll make sure she's safely out of the way while all this is happening, if that's what you're worried about."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We won't be able to get her out of..."
entries.dialogueText: "We won't be able to get her out of Pales without resorting to violence. Sometimes it's the only solution."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're getting ahead of yourself...."
entries.dialogueText: "You're getting ahead of yourself. It will never come to violence."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""That's the minimum I expect.""

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""With all due respect, Your Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, Your Majesty, it takes more of a spine to resist violence than to give in to it."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""That may be so in matters of war,..."
entries.dialogueText: "That may be so in matters of war, but it's a dangerous line of thinking in internal politics..."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""For all of our sakes, I hope not.""
entries.dialogueText: "For all of our sakes, I hope not."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina has nothing to do with this...."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina has nothing to do with this. It's none of your business what she'll think."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""None of my business? I'm her husba..."
entries.dialogueText: "None of my business? I'm her husband!"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""But as I said, if this is really w..."
entries.dialogueText: "But as I said, if this is really what you want, I won't get in your way."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Fine. As I said, if this is truly..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. As I said, if this is truly what you want, I won't get in your way."
